audit_rules.title: Root element uses correct class
audit_rules.check: Root element must have class 'code-snippet'.

audit_rules.title: Single-line modifier applied when variant is single-line
audit_rules.check: Single-line variant must have class 'code-snippet--single' on root.

audit_rules.title: Tab bar has role=tablist
audit_rules.check: .code-snippet__tab-bar must have role='tablist'.

audit_rules.title: Tab bar has aria-label
audit_rules.check: .code-snippet__tab-bar must have a non-empty aria-label.

audit_rules.title: Each tab has role=tab
audit_rules.check: Every .code-snippet__tab must have role='tab'.

audit_rules.title: Exactly one tab is aria-selected=true
audit_rules.check: Exactly one .code-snippet__tab must have aria-selected='true' at any time.

audit_rules.title: Inactive tabs have aria-selected=false
audit_rules.check: Non-active .code-snippet__tab elements must have aria-selected='false'.

audit_rules.title: Inactive tabs have tabindex=-1
audit_rules.check: Non-active tabs must have tabindex='-1' for keyboard roving tabindex pattern.

audit_rules.title: Code panel has role=tabpanel
audit_rules.check: The content area (code panel) must have role='tabpanel'.

audit_rules.title: Code panel has aria-labelledby
audit_rules.check: Code panel must have aria-labelledby pointing to its controlling tab.
audit_rules.expected: present and matches a tab id

audit_rules.title: Code is inside <pre><code>
audit_rules.check: .code-snippet__code must be a <pre> element containing a <code> child.

audit_rules.title: Line numbers are aria-hidden
audit_rules.check: .code-snippet__gutter must have aria-hidden='true'.

audit_rules.title: Copy button has aria-label
audit_rules.check: .code-snippet__copy must have a non-empty aria-label.

audit_rules.title: Copy button is type=button
audit_rules.check: .code-snippet__copy must have type='button'.

audit_rules.title: Show More button has aria-expanded
audit_rules.check: .code-snippet__show-more must have aria-expanded attribute.

audit_rules.title: Show More button is type=button
audit_rules.check: .code-snippet__show-more must have type='button'.

audit_rules.title: data-code-snippet attribute present on root
audit_rules.check: Root element should have data-code-snippet for JS targeting.

audit_rules.title: Tab aria-controls references valid panel id
audit_rules.check: aria-controls value on each tab must match a valid element id in the DOM.

audit_rules.title: No hardcoded color values in component CSS
audit_rules.check: component CSS must not contain hex, rgb, or rgba color literals in component selectors.

audit_rules.title: No hardcoded spacing values in component CSS
audit_rules.check: Component CSS must not contain raw px/rem spacing in component selectors (fallback values inside var() are allowed).

audit_rules.title: Focus ring visible on tab buttons
audit_rules.check: .code-snippet__tab:focus-visible must produce a visible focus indicator.

audit_rules.title: Focus ring visible on copy button
audit_rules.check: .code-snippet__copy:focus-visible must produce a visible focus indicator.

audit_rules.title: Single-line prompt span present when prompt exists
audit_rules.check: .code-snippet__prompt should be present inside .code-snippet--single when a prompt keyword is shown.

audit_rules.title: Inline code uses .code-snippet__inline-code class
audit_rules.check: Single-line command text must use .code-snippet__inline-code class.
